name: @mira/slack
description: Mira Slack bot — Socket Mode bridge to Mira HTTP API (thin client, no server changes)

scripts.dev: if [ -z "$SLACK_BOT_TOKEN" ] && ! grep -q "^SLACK_BOT_TOKEN=.\+" .env 2>/dev/null; then echo "[mira-slack] No Slack credentials — skipping (set SLACK_BOT_TOKEN to enable)"; exit 0; fi; bun --watch src/bot.ts
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && bun build src/bot.ts --outdir dist --target bun
